entities.name: Mircea II of Wallachia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mircea II (1428–1447) was the Voivode, or prince, of Wallachia in 1442. He was the oldest son of Vlad II Dracul and brother of Vlad Țepeș and Radu cel Frumos. He was the grandson of his namesake Mircea the Elder.
